QuestInfo.name: Phantom's Last Hideaway
QuestInfo.1: You found the last Secret Storage Room in Leafre. A Guardioso is standing near it, which Phantom once mentioned spending a ton of money on. He would be super mad if you did anything to it, so you'd better look for other options.
QuestInfo.2: Despite the Guardioso, you were able to get into the storage room pretty easily.

0.msg: This is pretty well-built. Phantom wasn't lying when he said he put a lot of money into it. I don't think I should try smashing it...

2.msg: Uh-oh! I should go, I don't want it to attack me...
